name: Hayakawa Kureha
source:
Specialities: martial arts in general, exorcism
Weakness: relationships with men 
Hobby: collecting weapons

A taciturn and unsociable boyish girl. Possesses great knowledge of the arts. Dislikes feminine clothing and wears her school uniform's skirt out of necessity. She has many black pantsuits in her dresser at home. Seems like she is somehow connected to [url=/c82194]Alcon[/url]...

[Translated from [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/jin/rena/kureha.html]Scramble HOUSE's official website[/url]]
